latest_release.body:
# 🚀 qData v1.6.8 发布说明

## 🧭 版本概述

本版本新增**资产字段敏感等级绑定**，支持按字段查看、修改和清除绑定。同时统一多个页面的**表格空状态插图**，并调整**页签主题色**。

## 🛠 主要更新内容

### 1️⃣ 数据资产管理

- 将资产字段编辑界面中的「数据分类」选择项替换为「敏感等级」，支持**绑定、查看、修改和清除**字段的敏感等级。
- 更新资产字段时，若请求**未传入敏感等级**，系统保留原有绑定。需要解除绑定时，可执行**清除**操作。
- 补充敏感等级绑定、修改和清除操作的**多语言提示与实现说明**。

### 2️⃣ 界面优化

- 统一**消息通知、分类、项目角色和日志**页面的表格空状态插图。
- 将页签在**选中和悬停**时的文字颜色调整为当前主题色，选中指示线同步采用主题色。

## 📌 版本总结

本次迭代将敏感等级细化到资产字段，维护字段的其他属性时无需重复提交已有等级。多个页面的空状态和页签反馈也更加一致。

![qData open-source data platform](images/en-US/banner.png)

📖简体中文 | 📖English | 📖日本語

## Platform overview **Lightweight, easy to use, full-featured, and AI-native. Get started on your own or deploy in production with your team.** qData is an open-source data platform for enterprise data teams and individual developers. It brings together **data integration, data pipeline development, data modeling, data governance, a data catalog, data APIs, and AI-assisted analytics**. It covers the data workflow from ingestion and transformation to organization, governance, and sharing. Use qData for individual development and evaluation, enterprise data projects, and day-to-day development and production operations. It helps individual developers run real data workloads and teams put data to use in business applications. ✨✨✨**Documentation**✨✨✨ https://docs.qdata.tech/en/qData/ ✨✨✨**Open-Source Edition demo**✨✨✨ https://demo.qdata.tech (username `qData`, password `qData123`) ✨✨✨**Professional Edition demo**✨✨✨ https://pro-demo.qdata.tech · [Request a demo account](https://docs.qdata.tech/en/business/policy.html) > If qData is useful to you, give the repository a **star ⭐️**! 🚀 qData is available under the Apache License 2.0 with additional qData terms. See [LICENSE](LICENSE) and [commercial licensing](#license-and-services). ## Key features ### Start on one machine and scale as needed qData supports **self-hosted deployment on one machine or as a scaled-out setup**. The default setup runs one qData instance, single-node SeaTunnel Zeta, DolphinScheduler Standalone, MySQL, and Redis. You can run data jobs with all of these components on one machine. ### Build and operate ETL pipelines, from sync to production Handle **data synchronization, script development, workflow orchestration, scheduling, and operations** in one place. Sync individual tables or entire databases in batch or in real time, and write tasks in **RDS SQL, Doris SQL, or shell scripts**. Reuse templates, set task dependencies, monitor runs, and retry failures to make data jobs easier to build and more reliable to run. ### Data warehouse modeling from business planning to model publishing Plan business domains and warehouse layers, define logical models and business metrics, and publish the models. Managing models, metrics, and data standards together keeps data structures and business definitions consistent and makes models easier to reuse. ### AI-native assistance across the data workflow Use natural-language interaction, AI-assisted generation, and analysis across **pipeline development, task setup, operations, and data analysis**. Ask questions in plain language and get **generated SQL (text-to-SQL), charts, and written insights** to help you query and understand your data. ### From data ingestion to business use in one platform Build data pipelines, govern data, manage the data catalog, and share datasets and APIs in one platform. Project workspaces, member roles, and system administration help teams manage the full workflow from ingestion and transformation to everyday use. ### Extend functionality and scale deployment The modular architecture lets you extend data source connectors, application modules, cleansing rules, and data quality checks. Reuse business logic through SQL, shell scripts, and task templates. Scale job execution and scheduling as workloads grow. ### High availability with multiple instances and clusters For production workloads that need higher availability, run multiple qData instances and deploy SeaTunnel Zeta and DolphinScheduler in clusters. Monitor runs and use execution logs, retries, and sync recovery to diagnose and recover from failures. ## Quick start ### Try the live demo Open the [qData Open-Source Edition demo](https://demo.qdata.tech) to explore the product in your browser. **Username `qData` · Password `qData123`** Start with pipeline development and data modeling. Then explore the data catalog, data APIs, and natural-language queries to see how data goes from preparation to use. ### Choose a deployment method - **[Docker Compose](https://docs.qdata.tech/en/qData/deploy/docker-compose-deployment.html)** — Set up and start a local environment for evaluation or deployment. - **[Run from source](https://docs.qdata.tech/en/qData/deploy/build-from-source.html)** — Start the frontend and backend for development and extensions. - **[Manual deployment](https://docs.qdata.tech/en/qData/deploy/manual-deployment/)** — Install and manage each service on existing infrastructure or with a custom configuration. See the [deployment guide](https://docs.qdata.tech/en/qData/deploy/deploy-open-source.html) for requirements, installation, configuration, and troubleshooting. ## Product architecture ![qData Open-Source Edition product architecture](images/en-US/product-architecture.png) ## Screenshots ![Login page](images/en-US/system/1-login.png) ![Home page](images/en-US/system/2-home.png) ![Data integration](images/en-US/system/22-data-integration.png) ![Create a data integration task](images/en-US/system/23-add-data-integration-task.png) ![Pipeline development](images/en-US/system/12-data-development.png) ![Create a pipeline task](images/en-US/system/24-add-data-development-task.png) ![Metadata collection](images/en-US/system/20-data-collection.png) ![Create a metadata collection task](images/en-US/system/21-add-collection-task.png) ![Data catalog](images/en-US/system/10-asset-management.png) ![Data quality results](images/en-US/system/9-quality-execution-analysis.png) ![Configure a data API](images/en-US/system/13-configure-api.png) ![AI data query conversation](images/en-US/system/5-ai-data-qa-conversation.png) ## Capabilities overview | Core capability | Highlights | | --- | --- | | **30+ types of data sources** | Connect to widely used databases, databases developed in China, data warehouses, message queues, and file storage to move data across disparate systems. | | **Comprehensive data integration** | Run batch sync, real-time change data capture (CDC), and full-database sync, with support for full and incremental loads and migrations across databases. | | **One-stop data development** | Combine ETL, SQL development, DAG workflows, cron scheduling, and job operations in one platform, from development through production. | | **Enterprise data warehouse modeling** | Build a warehouse with five layers (ODS, DIM, DWD, DWS, and ADS). Use logical models, a shared metrics framework, and data standards to keep the warehouse consistent. | | **End-to-end data governance** | Bring together metadata management, data standards, quality checks, and data lineage to govern data from discovery through quality control. | | **Data assets and service publishing** | Catalog data assets, find them with intelligent search, query them with SQL, and publish them as API services. | | **AI agents for data development and analysis** | AI agents and assistants help with data development and let you ask questions about data in natural language, generate SQL, analyze charts, and uncover insights. | See the [feature comparison](https://docs.qdata.tech/en/qData/pro/features.html) for details, supported data sources, and availability by edition. ## Lightweight by default, scalable for production Start with a lightweight setup for individual development, evaluation, and routine jobs. For larger workloads or higher availability, deploy multiple instances and cluster the services as needed. | Component | Lightweight defaults | Production scaling options | | --- | --- | --- | | **qData** | Single instance | Multiple instances for high availability | | **SeaTunnel Zeta** | Single node running sync jobs | Distributed cluster to increase execution capacity | | **DolphinScheduler** | Standalone node for job scheduling | Cluster to scale scheduling and execution | | **MySQL** | Stores application data | High-availability database configuration as needed | | **Redis** | Provides caching | High-availability cache configuration as needed | | **ZooKeeper** | No separate deployment required | Deploy as required by the cluster configuration | Flink and Spark can be integrated when needed. See the [feature comparison](https://docs.qdata.tech/en/qData/pro/features.html) for available task types and edition coverage. The lightweight configuration reduces initial setup, resource use, and maintenance. The scaled-out configuration adds capacity and availability. Choose the combination that fits your workload as it grows. ## Development and extensions qData separates the frontend and backend and uses a modular design to make it easier to navigate the code, integrate with other systems, and extend the platform. | Layer | Main technologies | | --- | --- | | Backend | Spring Boot, Spring Security, MyBatis-Plus | | Frontend | Vue 3, Element Plus, Vite | | Default sync and scheduling | SeaTunnel Zeta, DolphinScheduler | | Application storage and cache | MySQL or DM8 (Dameng 8), plus Redis | | Optional compute engines | Flink, Spark, and other engines as needed | Start by adding scripts, reusing task templates, or extending cleansing and quality rules. You can also customize modules and data source connectors. See the [source setup guide](https://docs.qdata.tech/en/qData/deploy/build-from-source.html) for the development environment and startup instructions. ## License and commercial services qData is available under **the Apache License 2.0 with additional qData terms** and permits commercial use. Follow [LICENSE](LICENSE), including its requirements for retaining the logo, copyright notices, license notices, and attribution. Obtain separate commercial authorization to remove or change the required branding or notices, including for white-labeling, OEM distribution, or rebranding. See [commercial licensing and support](https://docs.qdata.tech/en/business/policy.html) for branding authorization, the Professional Edition, and technical services. ## Our mission and vision **Make a full set of data tools affordable for every developer and organization.** We want data tools to be easier to use, datasets easier to trust, and applications easier to put into production. qData brings developers together through open source, makes data work more accessible through AI, and gives individuals and teams the tools to turn ideas into applications and put their data to use. Together with the community, we want to build a platform that people can use and extend for the long term, so more people can work with their own data and build on it.

## 平台简介 **轻量易用，功能完整，AI 原生。让个人轻松上手，让企业落地生产。** qData 是一款面向企业数据团队与个人开发者的开源数据中台，集 **数据接入、数据研发、数据建模、数据治理、数据资产、API 数据服务与智能分析** 于一体，覆盖数据从接入、加工、组织、治理到共享应用的完整业务链路。 从个人开发与技术验证，到企业数据项目、日常研发与生产运维，qData 帮助个人完成真实的数据任务，帮助企业把数据能力用到实际业务中。 ✨✨✨**在线文档**✨✨✨ https://docs.qdata.tech/qData/ ✨✨✨**开源版演示地址**✨✨✨ https://demo.qdata.tech ，账号：`qData` 密码：`qData123` ✨✨✨**专业版演示地址**✨✨✨ https://pro-demo.qdata.tech ，演示账号请 [联系客服获取](https://docs.qdata.tech/business/policy.html) > 如果 qData 对您有帮助，请点个 **Star ⭐️**，这是我们持续更新的最大动力！ 🚀 许可：Apache License 2.0 及 qData 附加条件，详见 [LICENSE](LICENSE) 与[商用说明](#license-and-services)。 ## 核心特点 ### 轻量易用：单机起步，按需扩展 提供 **轻量默认、企业扩展两种部署形态**。默认采用单实例 qData、单节点 SeaTunnel Zeta 与 DolphinScheduler Standalone，配合 MySQL、Redis 即可组织数据任务，无需先搭建一整套大数据集群。 ### 强大数据研发：从数据同步到生产运维，一站贯通 贯通 **同步、开发、编排、调度与运维**，支持离线/实时、单表/整库同步及 **RDS SQL、Doris SQL、Shell 三类脚本开发**。结合模板复用、任务依赖、运行监控与失败重试，提升数据生产效率与运行可靠性。 ### 强大数据建模：从业务规划到模型落地，全流程贯通 贯通业务规划、数仓分层、逻辑建模、指标定义与模型发布，实现从业务设计到模型落地。通过模型、指标与标准协同，统一数据结构和业务口径，提升模型复用与开发效率。 ### AI 原生：面向数据全流程的智能协作 以自然语言交互、智能生成与辅助分析连接 **数据开发、任务配置、运行运维与数据分析**。智能问数支持 **Text2SQL、智能图表与文字洞察**，帮助用户高效查询、理解和使用数据。 ### 功能完整：从数据接入到业务应用，全链路覆盖 统一组织数据生产、治理、资产管理与共享应用，配套项目空间、成员角色和系统管理。团队可以在同一平台连续完成数据的接入、加工、管理与使用。 ### 易扩展：按业务增加能力，按规模扩展部署 采用模块化架构，支持数据源适配、业务模块、清洗与稽查规则的扩展和二次开发。通过 SQL、Shell 与模板复用业务逻辑，按任务规模扩展执行与调度组件。 ### 高可用：支持多实例与集群部署，面向持续运行 支持 qData 多实例、SeaTunnel Zeta 分布式集群及 DolphinScheduler 集群，构建面向生产的运行环境。结合实例监控、运行日志、失败重试与同步恢复，让任务状态可观测、运行异常可处理。 ## 快速开始 ### 在线体验 访问 [qData 开源版演示环境](https://demo.qdata.tech)，无需安装即可了解产品。 **账号：`qData`　密码：`qData123`** 推荐先体验数据研发与数据建模，再查看数据资产、API 服务和智能问数，了解数据从生产到使用的完整过程。 ### 选择部署方式 - **[Docker Compose 部署](https://docs.qdata.tech/qData/deploy/docker-compose-deployment.html)**：按文档配置并启动本地环境，适合快速体验与部署。 - **[源码启动](https://docs.qdata.tech/qData/deploy/build-from-source.html)**：启动前后端开发环境，开展二次开发与功能扩展。 - **[自主部署](https://docs.qdata.tech/qData/deploy/manual-deployment/)**：自行安装与管理服务，适合已有基础设施及个性化部署需求。 环境要求、安装步骤、组件配置与常见问题，统一查阅[部署指南](https://docs.qdata.tech/qData/deploy/deploy-open-source.html)。 ## 产品功能架构 ![qData 数据中台开源版产品功能架构图](images/zh-CN/product-architecture.png) ## 系统配图
## 能力概览 | 核心能力 | 能力亮点 | | --- | --- | | **30+ 种异构数据源** | 广泛兼容主流数据库、国产数据库、数据仓库、消息队列及文件存储，打破异构数据壁垒。 | | **全场景数据集成** | 覆盖离线同步、实时 CDC、整库同步，支持全量、增量及跨库数据迁移，构建高效数据流转体系。 | | **一站式数据研发** | 集 ETL、SQL 开发、DAG 工作流、Cron 调度、运行运维于一体，覆盖数据开发到生产运行全流程。 | | **企业级数仓建模** | 支持 ODS、DIM、DWD、DWS、ADS 五层数仓架构，融合逻辑建模、指标体系与数据标准，构建规范化数仓体系。 | | **全链路数据治理** | 深度融合元数据管理、数据标准、质量稽查与数据血缘，构建从数据发现到质量管控的治理闭环。 | | **数据资产与服务开放** | 打通数据资产编目、智能检索、SQL 查询与 API 服务发布，实现数据资产化与服务化。 | | **AI Agent 智能赋能** | 融合 AI 智能体、智能问数、AI 助手与智能研发辅助，支持自然语言交互、SQL 智能生成、图表分析与数据洞察，推动数据研发与分析智能化。 | 详细功能、支持的数据源与各版本的功能范围，请查看[功能对照表](https://docs.qdata.tech/qData/pro/features.html)。 ## 轻量默认，企业级扩展 两种部署形态服务于不同的使用规模：个人开发、技术验证及日常数据任务可从轻量形态开始；企业可根据任务规模与可用性要求，扩展为多实例和集群部署。 | 组件 | 轻量默认形态 | 企业扩展形态 | | --- | --- | --- | | **qData** | 单实例 | 多实例，支持高可用扩展 | | **SeaTunnel Zeta** | 单节点，执行数据同步任务 | 分布式集群，扩展任务执行能力 | | **DolphinScheduler** | Standalone 单节点，统一任务调度 | 集群部署，扩展调度与任务执行能力 | | **MySQL** | 存储平台运行数据 | 按生产要求配置数据库高可用方案 | | **Redis** | 提供缓存服务 | 按生产要求配置缓存高可用方案 | | **ZooKeeper** | 默认形态无需独立部署 | 按集群方案部署 | Flink、Spark 等计算引擎可纳入扩展架构，按业务需要对接。具体任务开发类型与开放范围见[功能对照表](https://docs.qdata.tech/qData/pro/features.html)。 轻量化着重降低默认部署、资源使用和维护的负担；企业扩展着重提升运行规模与可用性。开发者可围绕同一平台，根据业务阶段选择合适的部署组合。 ## 开发与扩展 qData 采用前后端分离与模块化设计，便于开发者理解代码、接入业务系统和扩展功能。 | 层次 | 主要技术 | | --- | --- | | 后端 | Spring Boot、Spring Security、MyBatis-Plus | | 前端 | Vue 3、Element Plus、Vite | | 默认同步与调度 | SeaTunnel Zeta、DolphinScheduler | | 平台运行存储与缓存 | MySQL / 达梦8 二选一、Redis | | 扩展计算引擎 | Flink、Spark 等按需接入的计算组件 | 可以从新增业务脚本、复用任务模板、扩展清洗与稽查规则开始，也可以进一步定制业务模块和数据源适配。开发环境与启动方式见[源码启动指南](https://docs.qdata.tech/qData/deploy/build-from-source.html)。 ## QQ交流群 欢迎加入 qData 官方 QQ 交流群，获取最新动态、技术支持与使用交流。 👉 点击加入 QQ 交流群 ## 许可与商业服务 qData 按 **Apache License 2.0 及项目附加条件**提供，支持商业使用。使用时需遵守 [LICENSE](LICENSE)，保留其中要求的 Logo、版权、许可与署名信息。 如需去除或修改相关标识、白标、OEM 或重新包装为其他产品，请取得相应商业授权。品牌定制授权、专业版与技术服务咨询，请查看[商业合作说明](https://docs.qdata.tech/business/policy.html)。 ## 我们的使命与愿景 **让每一位开发者、每一家企业，都能以可负担的成本掌握完整的数据能力。** 我们相信，数据平台应当让技术更易用，让数据更可信，让应用更容易落地。qData 以开源汇聚开发者的创造力，以 AI 降低数据工作的门槛，以完整、开放、可靠的产品承接真实业务，让个人的想法能够成为应用，让企业的数据能够持续创造价值。 我们希望与社区共同建设一个可以长期使用、持续扩展的数据基础平台，让更多人自主掌握数据，让更多创新从数据中发生。
